claim_one_line: THE LAW_MAP SCOPE AUDIT, commissioned by the owner after B964 to catch the error class no gate can see. METHOD, mechanical not editorial: for each of LAW_MAP's 165 claim rows, load every arc it cites and check whether scope-limiting language present in the ARC'S OWN VERDICT is ABSENT from the row (markers: only-for, scope, assumes, not-established, conditional, up-to, one-prime, not-certified, NOT-claimed, post-hoc, inferred, cited-not-re-derived, screened, necessary-not-sufficient, limits, does-not) -- asking uniformly whether the row claims MORE than its own arc does. THE RESULT IS THE FINDING: 165 rows audited, 5 flagged, ZERO of them written before today, ALL FIVE written today, 3 needing real fixes. Zero of the older rows overclaim. That is a diagnosis about RATE, not competence: the corpus built slowly is scoped correctly, the corpus built in one day is not. ADJUDICATION: 'NO CENTRALIZER CONSTRUCTION REACHES RANK 4' PASSES (it carries 'SCOPE NOW UNCONDITIONAL (B960)' and names '(Steinberg)' as its citation -- the heuristic fired on an already-amended row). FIX 1, 'THE TWO SEEDS HAVE COMPLEMENTARY DEFECTS', stated an INFERENCE AS A FACT: the shed directions U(1)_psi and U(1)_chi are INFERRED from the rank bookkeeping and not computed, which B953's own verdict says explicitly and the row did not. FIX 2, 'TAU DOES DOUBLE DUTY', presented CITED STANDARD FACTS AS ESTABLISHED HERE: the three equivalences (w0 = -tau; -1 in W <=> self-dual; outer involutions = tau) are standard and were cited, not re-derived, while only tau's existence and the 63 gradings were computed. FIX 3, 'THE F4 WALL IS THE GENERIC VEV', used 'VEV' BARE -- THE EXACT ERROR CLASS B964 RETRACTED ONE HOUR EARLIER -- since every VEV in that row is a 27 VEV while adjoint VEVs are the measurement cascade and behave OPPOSITELY; corrected with B964's rule cited inline so the row now teaches the distinction it depends on. WHAT THIS SAYS ABOUT THE FAILURE MODE: the most uncomfortable finding is FIX 3, that an error class was diagnosed, retracted, given a rule, and then SURVIVED UNFIXED in a row written the same day -- RETRACTING A CLAIM DOES NOT RETRACT ITS INSTANCES, so a retraction needs a SWEEP and not merely a correction. Second, the audit's discriminating power came entirely from comparing a row to ITS OWN ARC'S VERDICT, and in all three fixes the arc's verdict was CORRECT and appropriately scoped -- the loss happened in the SUMMARISATION step, which localises the problem precisely: the arcs are honest, the LAW_MAP rows compress them, and compression drops qualifiers. REGISTERED: L139 RETRACTION SWEEPS (when a claim is retracted, sweep for its INSTANCES across LAW_MAP, CAMPAIGN_STATUS, README and the ledgers rather than merely correcting the source; FIX 3 is the proof it is needed) and L140 THE COMPRESSION STEP IS THE LEAK (every fix here was a qualifier lost when an arc verdict was compressed into a row; candidate gate: a row citing an arc whose verdict contains a scope marker must carry a scope marker of its own -- mechanical, and it would have caught all three). LIMITS: the scan is a KEYWORD HEURISTIC that can miss a scope loss phrased without its markers and fired once on a correctly-scoped row, so it is a triage tool and not a proof of correctness; only LAW_MAP was audited, while CAMPAIGN_STATUS, README and the PROGRESS_LOG headlines carry compressed claims too and are NOT covered; and 'zero older rows flagged' means zero flagged BY THIS HEURISTIC, not that the older corpus is clean.
